speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) secondary to recent upper respiratory infection.

*Correction based on clinical reasoning:* While the patient describes a "sustained" spinning sensation, BPPV typically presents with episodic vertigo triggered by head position changes lasting seconds to minutes. The description of "low grade and constant" vertigo since this morning is atypical for isolated BPPV and raises concern for vestibular neuritis or other etiologies. I will proceed with a focused examination to clarify the nature of the vertigo.

REQUEST TEST: Dix-Hallpike maneuver and Head Impulse Test.
